blocks.label: Intro paragraph
blocks.value:
Possums may appear harmless at first, but they can cause serious problems for both residential and commercial properties. Being highly active at night, possums commonly enter roof spaces where they create loud scratching and thumping noises that disturb sleep. Over time, they can damage roof structures, insulation, electrical wiring, and tiles, increasing the risk of costly repairs. Possum droppings and urine can also impact hygiene and indoor air quality, creating unpleasant odours and potential health concerns.

If you are experiencing possum activity or hearing constant movement in your roof and are searching for professional possum pest control in Melbourne, you are in the right place.
 At 7 State Pest Control, we provide licensed possum removal in Melbourne, humane possum trapping, and effective possum control solutions tailored to your specific situation. Our experienced team ensures safe, legal, and long-term possum control for residential and commercial properties.

metadata.title: 1. Possums in Roof Spaces
metadata.description: Possums often enter roof cavities and cause loud scratching and thumping noises at night. They can damage insulation, wiring, and roofing materials.

metadata.title: 2. Possum Damage to Property
metadata.description: Possums chew electrical wires and damage wood, roof tiles, and vents. This can lead to costly repairs and increase fire and safety risks.

metadata.title: 3. Possum Nesting & Breeding
metadata.description: Possums build nests in roofs, sheds, and wall cavities. Breeding can increase numbers quickly, leading to more noise, odours, and infestation issues.

metadata.title: 4.Possum Droppings & Hygiene Issues
metadata.description: Possum droppings and urine contaminate roof spaces, affect air quality, and cause strong odours. Professional control helps restore hygiene safely.

blocks.label: Section title
blocks.value: Why Are Possums Coming Onto Your Property?

blocks.label: List HTML
blocks.value:
1. Food Availability – Fruit trees, vegetable gardens, pet food, and rubbish attract possums.

     

  2. Shelter & Nesting – Possums look for warm, safe spaces in roof cavities, wall gaps, sheds, and trees.

     

  3. Urban Expansion – Ongoing development reduces natural habitats, pushing possums into residential areas.

     

  4. Breeding Season – Possum activity increases during breeding periods, leading to more noise and movement.

     

  5. Easy Access Points – Broken roof tiles, vents, and gaps make it easy for possums to enter.

metadata.title: Electrical & Fire Risks

metadata.title: Breeding & Infestation Growth

metadata.title: Garden & Property Damage

blocks.label: Intro HTML
blocks.value: Possums are highly adaptable and often enter properties seeking food and shelter. Preventing possum infestations requires proactive steps to block access, remove attractants, and secure roof spaces.

tips.title: 1. Secure Food Sources
list: Do not leave pet food outdoors overnight
Secure rubbish bins with tight-fitting lids
Clean up fallen fruits and food waste regularly

tips.title: 2. Trim Trees & Branches
list: Cut back branches near your roof.
Remove climbing paths to your home.
Keep trees and shrubs away from walls.

tips.title: 3. Seal Entry Points
list: Check roofs, vents, and eaves for gaps.
Install mesh over chimney and vent openings.
Seal holes with timber or metal sheets.

tips.title: 4. Remove Shelter Options
list: Declutter garages, sheds, and woodpiles.
Keep roof spaces clean and inaccessible.
Store outdoor furniture securely.

tips.title: 5. Use Motion-Activated Lights
list: Install lights near rooflines and gardens.
Lights startle possums and discourage visits.
Combine with noise deterrents for best effect.

tips.title: 6. Install Possum-Proof Fencing
list: Add smooth metal sheets to fences.
Ensure fences are high and free from gaps.
Check fences regularly for weak spots.

tips.title: 7. Apply Safe Deterrents
list: Use natural repellents like garlic or ammonia.
Commercial possum repellents around entry points.
Avoid poisons; use humane methods only.

items.question: 1. What is the cost of possum removal in Melbourne?
items.answer_html: Possum removal in Melbourne typically costs between $150 to $400 depending on the situation and access difficulty. 7 States Pest Control offers affordable and effective possum control services.

items.question: 2. Is possum removal legal in Melbourne?
items.answer_html: Yes, possums are protected in Australia, so removal must follow strict regulations. 7 States Pest Control uses legal and humane methods as per local laws.

items.question: 3. How do professionals remove possums safely?
items.answer_html: Professionals use humane trapping and relocation methods to safely remove possums. 7 States Pest Control ensures ethical and compliant pest control practices.

items.question: 4. How quickly can possum removal be done?
items.answer_html: Possum removal usually takes a few hours, but complete prevention may take longer depending on the property. 7 States Pest Control provides fast and reliable service.

items.question: 5. How can I prevent possums from entering my roof?
items.answer_html: To prevent possums, seal entry points, trim tree branches, and remove food sources. 7 States Pest Control also provides prevention solutions to stop re-entry.
